title: どんなに～ても — no matter how ～
summary: Says that the result stays the same however far the degree goes: “no matter how ～.” どんなに is followed by the て-form of a verb or adjective + も. The second half states something that does not change.

patterns.form: どんなに ＋ 動詞て形 ＋ も
patterns.gloss: どんなに頑張っても (no matter how hard I try)

patterns.form: どんなに ＋ い形容詞〜くても／な形容詞・名詞〜でも
patterns.gloss: どんなに高くても, どんなに有名でも

body.p: The first half raises the degree to the maximum, and the second half says that nothing changes: どんなに頑張っても、彼に勝てない. The result is often negative or a strong will or duty: どんなに疲れていても日記を書く.
いくら～ても means almost the same. どんなに can also be paired with the casual 〜たって. In the second half, you can use requests and intentions (unlike the plain ～ば), such as どんなに高くても買います.

examples.ja: どんなに頑張（がんば）っても、彼（かれ）に勝（か）てない。
examples.romaji: Donna ni ganbatte mo, kare ni katenai.
examples.tr: No matter how hard I try, I can't beat him.

examples.ja: どんなに疲（つか）れていても、日記（にっき）だけは毎日（まいにち）書（か）く。
examples.romaji: Donna ni tsukarete ite mo, nikki dake wa mainichi kaku.
examples.tr: No matter how tired I am, I write my diary every day.

examples.ja: どんなに高（たか）くても、この薬（くすり）は買（か）わなければならない。
examples.romaji: Donna ni takakute mo, kono kusuri wa kawanakereba naranai.
examples.tr: No matter how expensive it is, I have to buy this medicine.

pitfalls: Use the て-form + も: 頑張っても. Do not use the ば-form with どんなに.
For adjectives: い-adjective → くても, な-adjective and noun → でも.
